verdict.rationale: Bento documents reusable email templates that are created once, used across Sequences and Workflows, and update everywhere when changed. Templates can also be managed via the CLI. Custom subscriber fields exist, which only implies personalization. Missing for 10: evidence of a visual/drag-and-drop email editor, documented personalization tokens/merge tags, cross-client rendering guarantees or previews, on-brand styling controls, and independent corroboration.
